fib: ______ is the basis of Erving Goffman analysis of crime.
Interactionalism criminology

______ is a violation of norms of the land,-a deviation from or fail to conform to the norms.
Deviance
Deviance is a violation of norms of the land,-a deviation from or fail to conform to the norms.

Norms
Norms are the defined obligatory and expected behaviours of people in a given situation.

Psychoanalysis criminology

______ is defined as the agency set up by government to define and apply the law, to order its enforcement and to settle disputed points on which individual or groups do not agree.
court

Crime
Crime is defined as any act that violates the law.

Rules generally

______ are the acts or conducts that violate the criminal law of the society.
offenders

white-collar crime

felony

New criminology
